title: Bee Flow accessibility conformance artefact
description: Produced by .github/workflows/a11y-conformance.yml (Playwright + @axe-core/playwright over the product's own public surfaces) and shipped with the build as server/compliance/a11y/conformance.json. Read by the EAA-Art4-product-surfaces-conformance check. The file is a CI product — never hand-written, never committed as a fixture.

schema_version.description: Shape version of this document. Bump when a required field changes.

build_sha.description: The git SHA the tested images were built from. The check compares it to the running server's APP_BUILD_SHA; a mismatch marks the artefact stale.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the run. Older than 60 days counts as stale.

axe_version.description: Version of axe-core that produced the violations.

runner.description: Where and how the run happened — for the evidence row, not for the verdict.

tags.description: axe runOnly tags, e.g. wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, best-practice.

id.description: public_form = a hosted form (/f/<token> → /app/forms/<token>); public_app = an anonymous Studio app page (/p/<token>); dsr = the data-subject request form (/privacy/requests); webpage_viewer = a shared AI webpage (/share/<token>).

status.description: skipped surfaces (no fixture could be seeded, page failed to load) make the check warn — an untested surface is never a pass.

url_path.description: Path that was visited, with any token replaced by <token>. Never a full URL with a live token.

passes.description: Number of axe rules that passed on the surface.

incomplete.description: Number of axe rules that needed manual review.

rules.description: One entry per violated axe rule. Node targets are CSS selectors from the product's own markup — never page content or personal data.

id.description: axe rule id, e.g. color-contrast, label, link-name.

wcag.description: axe tags for the rule (wcag2aa, wcag143, …).

targets.description: Up to 10 CSS selectors of offending nodes.
